claims.text: The hotel sits in Downtown Vancouver's Stadium District, steps from BC Place Stadium and Rogers Arena.

findings.quote: places guests at the heart of Downtown Vancouver’s Stadium District—steps from BC Place Stadium and Rogers Arena

claims.text: The hotel sits along False Creek, with Yaletown and Granville Island close by.

findings.quote: From our elevated setting along False Creek, guests can move effortlessly into Yaletown’s chic dining and boutique culture or travel across the water to the artisan energy of Granville Island

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city, ocean and mountain views.

findings.quote: retreat to waterfront luxury accommodations with floor-to-ceiling windows and scenic city, ocean and mountain views

claims.text: Each two-bedroom Sky Suite has a personal media room at the heart of the suite.

findings.quote: our two bedroom luxury suites are bathed in light on three sides
Your personal media room occupies the heart of the suite

claims.text: The wellness floor includes a 4,240-square-foot fitness studio, steam rooms and a manicure and pedicure bar.

findings.quote: the space includes a 4,240-square-foot fitness studio, an Aqua Lounge terrace with a whirlpool, a manicure and pedicure bar, and steam rooms

claims.text: The Organic Honey Detox wellness journey uses raw honey from the hotel's resident JW Garden honeybees.

findings.quote: From the Organic Honey Detox — featuring raw honey from our resident JW Garden honeybees

claims.text: Guests have access to Parq Vancouver's 72,000-square-foot gaming facility, which includes private salons.

findings.quote: Access to Parq Vancouver’s 72,000 square-foot world class gaming facility features the latest advancements in gaming in a contemporary and natural light-infused environment, as well as private salons

claims.text: The hotel's accommodations are crafted to LEED Gold certification.

findings.quote: crafted to LEED Gold certification

claims.text: D/6 Lounge is an indoor/outdoor rooftop bar with views of the city skyline.

findings.quote: our hotel's hip, vibrant and exclusive indoor/outdoor rooftop bar in Vancouver, BC. Enjoy views of the city skyline alongside specialty cocktails and light bites.

claims.text: Pet-friendly rooms welcome one dog per room, up to 15 kg.

findings.quote: pet-friendly rooms welcome one dog per room (up to 15 kg)

claims.text: Spa by JW sits on the 17th-floor wellness level, overlooking BC Place and False Creek.

findings.quote: Spa by JW Vancouver offers a luxury day spa experience on the 17th-floor wellness level of JW Marriott Parq Vancouver. Overlooking BC Place and False Creek

claims.text: The rooftop Aqua Lounge is an outdoor pavilion with a hydrotherapy tub overlooking BC Place and False Creek.

findings.quote: Perched on the rooftop of the 17th floor, the Aqua Lounge is an outdoor pavilion overlooking BC Place and False Creek. Ease into the hydrotherapy tub

claims.text: The two-level Parq Villa has white oak floors and a 600-square-foot terrace with views of the False Creek waterfront.

findings.quote: the amenity-filled two-level Parq Villa is beyond compare
features white oak wooden floors throughout and a sliding wall of glass that grants access to a 600-square-foot terrace with views of False Creek waterfront

claims.text: The spa offers the Mind-Sync Harmonic Sleep Lounger, a zero-gravity chair that uses vibro-acoustic sound wave therapy.

findings.quote: The Mind-Sync Harmonic Sleep Lounger is a zero-gravity chair that uses Vibro-Acoustic sound wave therapy

claims.text: The Victor is a sixth-floor rooftop restaurant featuring Pacific Northwest seafood and specialty steaks.

findings.quote: The Victor, Parq Vancouver's sixth-floor rooftop restaurant in downtown Vancouver features a seasonally inspired menu highlighting Pacific Northwest seafood and specialty steaks.

claims.text: The Aqua Lounge is not a standard swimming pool.

findings.quote: Please note that this is not a standard swimming pool.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says it is not a place for travelers seeking a quiet or low-key experience; the hotel is attached to a casino.

findings.quote: This isn’t a place for a traveler looking for a more quiet or low key experience.
it is attached to a casino after all

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the casino environment may not appeal to all guests.
